dedupe_keys.name: sao paulo municipal culture facilities register libraries theatres cultural centres 2010 to 2024

description: Secretaria Municipal de Cultura (SMC) with SMDU, City of São Paulo publishes a register of all municipal culture facilities, compiled by the urban development information department from the media, the culture secretariat, the library system, the Centro Cultural São Paulo and the Mário de Andrade Library, with the space name, full address and district, published as 28 files including yearly versions from 2010 to 2024. Coverage: the municipality of São Paulo; the page says annual update, last on 10/11/2025, and the portal record was modified on 2026-06-26. Format and access: CSV, ODS, XLS, XLSX, downloadable without registration from the São Paulo municipal open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the register was collected manually from public sources, so completeness is not guaranteed; the files were not opened, so the columns and the count of facilities are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: public-space and community-facility layers for accessibility, heat-refuge and shelter analysis, and for exposure counts of cultural assets. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
